description: A flaw was found in a change made to path normalization in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49. An attacker could use a path traversal attack to map URLs to files outside the directories configured by Alias-like directives.

It was found that the fix for CVE-2021-41773 in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.50 was insufficient. An attacker could use a path traversal attack to map URLs to files outside the directories configured by Alias-like directives and execute code.

A signal handler race condition was found in OpenSSH's server (sshd) in glibc-based Linux systems. Under specific conditions, this condition can lead to unauthenticated remote code execution as root (regreSSHion).
The PKCS#11 provider in ssh-agent in OpenSSH before 9.3p2 has an untrusted search path that leads to remote code execution when an attacker can control forwarded ssh-agent sockets.
A 1-byte memory overwrite flaw in the resolver component of nginx allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service or potentially execute arbitrary code.
The BN_mod_sqrt function in OpenSSL, which computes a modular square root, contains a flaw that can cause it to loop indefinitely for non-prime moduli.
There is a type confusion vulnerability relating to X.400 address processing inside an X.509 GeneralName in OpenSSL.
A state manipulation issue in WebKit was addressed with improved state management.
